mirror_node.CRITICAL_threshold_key_opaque: A ThresholdKey/KeyList returns _type=ProtobufEncoded with key=hex of the serialized protobuf Key message. The mirror node does NOT expand threshold or sub-keys into JSON. Must decode the protobuf (via SDK Key parsing) to verify threshold=2 over 3 attester keys.

delegatecall_issue.summary: Calls into 0x16b from a DELEGATECALL frame (diamond/proxy) create schedules with a delegatable_contract_id admin key; scheduled execution fails INVALID_PAYER_SIGNATURE. Call 0x16b/0x167 from a DIRECT CALL frame only. Confirms the PRD 'no proxy/diamond' invariant.

s4_contract_keys.GOTCHA_alias_address: HTS grantTokenKyc(token, account) needs the account's ALIAS EVM address (keccak of ECDSA pubkey, = mirror evm_address), NOT the long-zero derived from the account id. Passing long-zero returned INVALID_ACCOUNT_ID (15). Tokens use long-zero (no alias). In the template, an investor-initiated enableAsset() uses msg.sender (the alias) naturally; only admin-provided-address grants must resolve the alias.

s3_hip755.note: attester1 signed via SDK, attester2 via ethers only; quorum reached -> auto mint. Confirms the wallet-mode attester path.

s1_saucerswap.status: PARTIAL (V1 PASS; V2 blocked by testnet fee misconfig, not KYC)

v2_blocker.cause: SaucerSwap V2 testnet Factory.poolCreateFee = 1e16 tinycent = $1,000,000 (tinycent = 1e-10 USD per IExchangeRate). PoolInitializer.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary reverts 'PCF' unless address(this).balance >= tinycentsToTinybars(poolCreateFee) ~ 1.28e15 tinybar ~ 12.8M HBAR. Factory.createPool has the same wall (require(msg.value >= convTinybar), msg.value is in TINYBARS on Hedera EVM).
v2_blocker.verdict: Unfixable by us (only the factory feeToSetter can setPoolCreateFee). A testnet misconfiguration vs mainnet (~$1). NOT a KYC limitation.
v2_blocker.hedera_unit_note: On Hedera EVM msg.value AND address(this).balance are in TINYBARS (1e8/HBAR), not weibars. ethers value (weibar) is divided by 1e10 by the relay before the call.

v1_pass.pair: 0.0.10670524 (CREATE2-deployed, NOT long-zero; resolve id via mirror /contracts/{evm})
v1_pass.investor_swap_verified: investor received 45330 share units from pool->investor (mirror verified)
v1_pass.outsider_refused_code: HTS ACCOUNT_KYC_NOT_GRANTED_FOR_TOKEN (176) at the deepest 0x167 action; SaucerSwap TransferHelper masks it as revert 'Safe token transfer failed!' at the pair/router
v1_pass.minimal_kyc_contract_set: ONLY the pair needs KYC (GRANTED). The router does NOT (UniV2 moves the token directly issuer->pair->recipient; the router never holds it -> its grant returned TOKEN_NOT_ASSOCIATED and is unnecessary).
v1_pass.ordering: create empty pair (factory.createPair, permissionless) FIRST -> resolve pair id -> grant KYC to pair -> add liquidity (addLiquidityETH). Avoids the atomic createPair+liquidity vs KYC-grant conflict.
v1_pass.gas: createPair needs ~9M gas (HTS self-association inside pair init); addLiquidityETH ~8M; swap ~6M. HTS ops inside contracts are gas-heavy.

s1_saucerswap.template_impact: Template ships SaucerSwap V1 as the KYC-gated venue on testnet, with V2 wiring + the documented testnet fee limitation. FR-7 error map must translate SaucerSwap 'Safe token transfer failed!' -> likely KYC-not-granted or paused (raw HTS code only visible in mirror action trace).
